items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Terminology 27:1
items.html: Bina is the phase of complete mercy, which the phase of restriction and judgment cannot touch even in the slightest, since she is in the secret of “for He delights in mercy”. For upon her light there was never any restriction whatsoever. Yet this is only in the phase of her HBD HGT, where she is in the secret of the round Samech, as is known. But in her TNHY, where the roots of ZON are, she already stands there to draw the illumination of Hochma for ZON, and therefore there is room there for the awakening of the judgments by force of the restriction. Hence she is called there by the secret of the closed Mem. And of that place, that is, from the Chazeh [chest] downward, it is said in the Zohar, “from Bina judgments awaken from her”. (Page 895, Item 45).
